pilot_gate: Stage0 A probe plateau at 40k-60k; finetune forgetting 0.03176; random replay modest gain, no severity gain. Proceed without tuning severity threshold or budgets.
scope: Primary detection impact20>2000 N/s only. Brier loss / P20 / continuous MSE and memory sensitivity remain separate secondary experiments.

memory.payload: float32 270D causal history + float32 8x4 target + int8 stratum + float64 priority key
memory.weights: past observed robot-interval prior / actual stored stratum fraction, both binary and severity

evaluation: Full fixed monitor at block boundaries; predeclared fixed 16384 robot intervals/domain probe each 1000 updates. Final test A0, B5 reference and C5, no best-checkpoint selection.

confirmation_criteria.tests: paired data replications after averaging two initializations; one-sided t tests vs +.01, Holm for two superiority tests; two-sided 95% paired effect CIs

alarms: Initial A calibrator and threshold; geometry rows modulo 3 = fit/selection/verification. Empirical selection FAR<=0.5, verification reported once. No operational utility claim without separate FAR gate.
collection_deviation: Use unchanged validated raw collector + exact converter; stage only one raw role and delete after native audit (env IDs 0,200,...). No unvalidated new streaming writer. Compact records 492 bytes/robot interval plus array headers and small audits.

analysis_locked_before_confirmation_trai.alarm_selection_candidates: 128 fixed tail quantiles and disabled candidate; maximize recall under empirical FAR<=0.5; ties prefer lower FAR then higher threshold
analysis_locked_before_confirmation_trai.CI: Two-sided Student t 95% paired intervals over five collections. No feet/frame pseudoreplication.

implementation_note: Before any confirmation training: deduplicate identical data gathers; same current draws and stationary/reference draws across two initializations, separate model parameters/Adam moments. Replay draws separate per model.
